sample_unit: chest X-ray images/reports (MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray datasets)

links.outcome: Patient comprehension score of AI-generated radiology reports adapted to plain-language reading levels
links.effect: 56.88% increase in patient comprehension scores reported, alongside 19.78% AUROC gain, 17.29% mAP improvement, and 5.26% gain in diagnostic precision (benchmark datasets, automated evaluation).
links.quote: Validation on MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray datasets demonstrated substantial improvements: 19.78% enhancement in classification accuracy (AUROC), 17.29% improvement in mean average precision, 56.88% increase in patient comprehension scores, and 5.26% gain in diagnostic precision.

unlisted_practices: Self-reflective LLM adaptation of report complexity to multiple reading levels (6th, 11th, 18th grade) while preserving clinical content
LLM-as-judge (Mistral-small) evaluation of report consistency, coverage, and fluency
Hybrid detection with anatomical localization (Eigen-CAM) to ground report generation

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an automated CXR report generation pipeline that incorporates self-reflective adaptation across multiple reading levels to improve patient comprehension while preserving diagnostic accuracy.
